Introduction

This script contains a bootstrap estimator for otolith samples collected where various hypothetical sampling rate scenarios (10-100% by 10% increments) are explored. Simulated age compositions are produced for a number of bootstrap samples designated by the user by stepping through the reported sampling dates for each year included and sampling otolith ages at the specified rate for each treatment. Effective sample size is then calculated for each sampling rate treatment and summarized as the harmonic mean (Stewart & Hamel, 2014; Eq. 6) across bootstrap replicates.

Setup, pull data, and format

Use this section to load libraries, set directories, and designate any life history or geographic groupings. Then read in the data, calculate brood year returns, and format for model fitting.

Code

rm(list=ls())

library(lubridate);library(janitor);library(stringi);library(rmdformats);
library(nlme);library(MuMIn);library(Hmisc);library(mgcv);library(scales);
library(odbc);library(RODBC);library(DBI);library(stringr);library(mgcv);
library(RJSONIO);library(RCurl);library(httr);library(jsonlite);library(glmmTMB);

### Set up drives, seed, & controls
drive          <-paste0("C:/Users/sism1477/OneDrive - Washington State Executive Branch Agencies/Desktop/R5 HM&E/wdfw_age_be/")
`%nin%`        <-negate(`%in%`) # create an exclude operator
# source(paste(drive,"/Functions/Functions.R",sep="")) #Source seed function to create seedlist; only run once then turn off
load(paste(drive,"/seed.list_v2",sep="")) #load seed folder again
bootest.seed <- as.numeric(seed.list[[1]][,"bootest.seed3"]) #read recruitment seed from seedlist function
n_boot <-1000 # settled on 1000

### Species designations
sp_name_list  <-c("Chum") #, "chinook", "pink", "coho", "sockeye", "steelhead", "cutthroat", "rainbow", "bull trout"

### Read-in age data & calc real age comps
# chum25                    <-read.csv(paste0(drive,"chum_ages_wallace_2025.csv"))
chum24                    <-read.csv(paste0(drive,"chum_ages_wallace_2024.csv"))
chum20_23                 <-read.csv(paste0(drive,"chum_ages_wallace_2020-2023.csv"))
age_data                  <-rbind(chum24[,c("species_description","location_name","sample_datetime", "gilbert_rich")],
                                  # chum25[,c("species_description","location_name","sample_datetime", "gilbert_rich")],
                                  chum20_23[,c("species_description","location_name","sample_datetime", "gilbert_rich")])
age_data                  <-filter(age_data, gilbert_rich!=c("Unreadable"))
age_data$return_yr        <-as.character(substr(age_data$sample_datetime,1,4))
age_data$return_yr        <-as.numeric(age_data$return_yr)
age_data$month_date       <-as.character(substr(age_data$sample_datetime,6,10))
age_data$gilbert_rich_int <-substr(chartr("₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉", "0123456789", age_data$gilbert_rich),1,1)
age_data$gilbert_rich_int <-as.numeric(age_data$gilbert_rich_int)

# Calculate N_bt
calculate_n = function(boot_ct, obs_ct){
  # boot_ct  = standardize(boot_ct)
  # obs_ct   = standardize(obs_ct)
  num_ct   = boot_ct*(1-boot_ct)
  denom_ct = (boot_ct - obs_ct)^2
  colSums(num_ct)/colSums(denom_ct)
}

# Calculate harmonic mean of N_bt
harmonic.mean = function(vec) 1/mean(1/vec)

Annual Estimator

Effective sample size is often used to gauge the level of information content present in each year of age composition data included in a stock assessment framework However, it can also be useful in a sampling design capacity to inform the agency on the quality of sampling efforts year-to-year. Therefore, this section of the script is designed to calculate an effective sample size for each sampling year and each user-specified sampling rate treatment.

Resample Age Data

The available age data are bootstrapped 1,000 times per scenario (sp X yr X trt), thus creating 1,000 simulated age comps per scenario.

Code 
### Set up bootstrapping parameters
age_comps_real_sp <-list()
age_comps_sim_trt <-list()
age_comps_sim_sp <-list()
age_data_sim <-list()
n_nom_sp <-list()
samp_rate <-c(seq(0.1,1,0.1))
# print(Sys.time())
# sp=b=1
# s=10
# y=4

for(sp in 1:length(sp_name_list)){
  age_comps_real <-list()
  n_nom_trt <-list()
  yrs <-sort(unique(dplyr::filter(age_data, species_description==sp_name_list[sp])$return_yr))

  for(s in 1:length(samp_rate)){
    age_comps_b <-list()
    n_nom_b <-list()
    # print(samp_rate[[s]])
    
    for(b in 1:n_boot){
      # print(b)
      set.seed(bootest.seed[b])
      age_comps_sim <-list()
      n_nom_y <-list()
      
      for(y in 1:length(yrs)){
        ### Calc real age comps for each year
        age_data_sp_y <-dplyr::filter(age_data, species_description==sp_name_list[sp] & return_yr==yrs[y])
        age_data_tab_real <-table(age_data_sp_y$gilbert_rich_int)
    
        age_vec   <-c(as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_real["1"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_real["1"],0)),
                        as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_real["2"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_real["2"],0)),
                        as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_real["3"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_real["3"],0)),
                        as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_real["4"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_real["4"],0)),
                        as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_real["5"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_real["5"],0)),
                        as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_real["6"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_real["6"],0)))
        
        age_comps_real[[y]] <-age_vec/sum(age_vec)
        
        samp_dates <-unique(age_data_sp_y$month_date)
        age_data_sim <-list()
        
        for(sd in 1:length(samp_dates)){
          
          # for(or in 1:length(origin)){
            age_data_sp_y_sd <-dplyr::filter(age_data_sp_y, month_date==samp_dates[sd])
            age_data_sim[[sd]] <-sample(age_data_sp_y_sd$gilbert_rich_int,size=floor(round(nrow(age_data_sp_y_sd)*samp_rate[s])),replace=TRUE)
          # }
        
        }
        names(age_data_sim) <-samp_dates
        age_data_sim_df <-map_df(age_data_sim,~as.data.frame(.))
        age_data_tab_sim <-table(age_data_sim_df)
        
        age_vec_sim<-c(as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_sim["1"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_sim["1"],0)),
                       as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_sim["2"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_sim["2"],0)),
                       as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_sim["3"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_sim["3"],0)),
                       as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_sim["4"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_sim["4"],0)),
                       as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_sim["5"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_sim["5"],0)),
                       as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_sim["6"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_sim["6"],0)))
  
        n_nom_y[[y]] <-sum(age_vec_sim)
        age_comps_sim[[y]] <-age_vec_sim/sum(age_vec_sim)
      }
      names(n_nom_y) <-yrs
      n_nom_b[[b]] <-n_nom_y
      names(age_comps_real) <-yrs
      names(age_comps_sim) <-yrs
      age_comps_b[[b]] <-age_comps_sim
    }
    n_nom_trt[[s]] <-n_nom_b
    age_comps_sim_trt[[s]] <-age_comps_b
  }
  names(n_nom_trt) <-samp_rate
  n_nom_sp[[sp]] <-n_nom_trt
  age_comps_real_sp[[sp]] <-age_comps_real
  names(age_comps_sim_trt) <-samp_rate
  age_comps_sim_sp[[sp]] <-age_comps_sim_trt
}
names(n_nom_sp) <-sp_name_list
names(age_comps_real_sp) <-sp_name_list
names(age_comps_sim_sp) <-sp_name_list

for(sp in 1:length(sp_name_list)){
  for(s in 1:length(samp_rate)){
    if(s==1){age_comps_sim_df <-cbind(as.data.frame(t(map_df(age_comps_sim_sp[[sp]][[s]],~as.data.frame(.)))),yrs)}
    if(s>1){
      temp <-cbind(as.data.frame(t(map_df(age_comps_sim_sp[[sp]][[s]],~as.data.frame(.)))),yrs)
      age_comps_sim_df <-rbind(temp, age_comps_sim_df)
    }
  }
}

Calculate data weights (n_eff) & plot

The simulated age comps are then compared to the real age comps using the following calculation:

INSERT EQ. 6 HERE

and the n_eff is calculated as the harmonic mean across bootstrap replicates.

Code 
# Set 'observed' proportions to real annual age comps, calc N_bt
# Could use mean of specimen bootstrap replicates if implemented 
samp_suite_sp <-list()

for(sp in 1:length(sp_name_list)){
  samp_suite <-list()
  
  for(trt in 1:length(samp_rate)){
    N_bt = matrix(NA, nrow=n_boot, ncol=length(yrs))
    colnames(N_bt) <-yrs
    # print(samp_rate[[trt]])
    
    for(y in 1:length(yrs)){
      for(bI in 1:n_boot){
        N_bt[bI,y] = t(calculate_n(boot_ct=map_df(age_comps_sim_sp[[sp]][[trt]][[bI]][[y]],~as.data.frame(.)), 
                                  obs_ct=map_df(age_comps_real_sp[[sp]][[y]],~as.data.frame(.))))
      }
    }
    # # Calculate input sample size (harmonic mean across bootstrap samples)
    Nsamp_t = array(NA,dim=length(yrs))
    Nsamp_t = apply(N_bt, MARGIN=2, FUN=harmonic.mean)
    samp_suite[[trt]] <-Nsamp_t

  }
  names(samp_suite) <-samp_rate
  samp_suite_sp[[sp]] <-samp_suite
}
names(samp_suite_sp) <-sp_name_list

fig_dat                <-map_df(samp_suite_sp,~as.data.frame(.))
colnames(fig_dat)      <-samp_rate
fig_dat$return_yr      <-rownames(fig_dat)
fig_dat_long           <-melt(setDT(fig_dat), id.vars = c("return_yr"), variable.name = "trt")
colnames(fig_dat_long) <-c("return_yr", "trt", "n_eff")
fig_dat_long           <-fig_dat_long[order(fig_dat_long$return_yr,fig_dat_long$trt),]

for(sp in 1:length(sp_name_list)){
  for(s in 1:length(samp_rate)){
    if(s==1){
      n_nom_df <-rbindlist(n_nom_sp[[sp]][[s]], fill=FALSE)
      n_nom_df$trt <-rep(samp_rate[[s]], n_boot)
    }
    if(s>1){
      temp <-rbindlist(n_nom_sp[[sp]][[s]], fill=FALSE)
      temp$trt <-rep(samp_rate[[s]], n_boot)
      n_nom_df <-rbind(n_nom_df, temp)
    }
  }
}

n_nom_df_long           <-melt(setDT(n_nom_df), id.vars = c("trt"), variable.name = "return_yr")
colnames(n_nom_df_long) <-c("trt","return_yr","n_nom")
n_nom_means             <-aggregate(n_nom ~ trt + return_yr, data = n_nom_df_long, FUN = mean)
n_nom_means$return_yr   <-as.character(n_nom_means$return_yr)
n_nom_means$trt         <-as.factor(n_nom_means$trt)
fig_dat_long            <-left_join(fig_dat_long, n_nom_means, by = c("return_yr","trt"))
fig_dat_long$n_diff     <-fig_dat_long$n_nom - fig_dat_long$n_eff

##### n_eff ~ n_nom
# Plot n_nom_means & n_eff across all return years
ggplot(data=fig_dat_long, aes(x=n_nom,y=n_eff,group=return_yr,fill=return_yr))+
  geom_point(size=3,pch=21)+
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed")+
  xlab("Mean Nominal Sample Size")+
  ylab("Calculated n_eff")

Species-level Estimator

In this section, effective sample size is calculated using all years of age data combined.

Resample Age Data

Code 
### Set up bootstrapping parameters
age_comps_real_sp <-list()
age_comps_sim_trt <-list()
age_comps_sim_sp <-list()
age_data_sim <-list()
n_nom_sp <-list()
samp_rate <-c(seq(0.1,1,0.1))
# print(Sys.time())
# sp=b=s=1

for(sp in 1:length(sp_name_list)){
  age_comps_real <-list()
  n_nom_trt <-list()

  ### Calc real age comps for each year
  age_data_sp <-dplyr::filter(age_data, species_description==sp_name_list[sp])
  age_data_tab_real <-table(age_data_sp$gilbert_rich_int)

  age_vec   <-c(as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_real["1"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_real["1"],0)),
                as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_real["2"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_real["2"],0)),
                as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_real["3"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_real["3"],0)),
                as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_real["4"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_real["4"],0)),
                as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_real["5"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_real["5"],0)),
                as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_real["6"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_real["6"],0)))
  
  age_comps_real[[sp]] <-age_vec/sum(age_vec)
  
  samp_dates <-sort(unique(age_data_sp$month_date))


  for(s in 1:length(samp_rate)){
    age_comps_b <-list()
    n_nom_b <-list()
    # message("Treatment: ",samp_rate[[s]])
    
    for(b in 1:n_boot){
      # print(b)
      set.seed(bootest.seed[b])
      age_comps_sim <-list()
      age_data_sim <-list()
        
      for(sd in 1:length(samp_dates)){
          age_data_sp_sd <-dplyr::filter(age_data_sp, month_date==samp_dates[sd])
          age_data_sim[[sd]] <-sample(age_data_sp_sd$gilbert_rich_int,size=floor(round(nrow(age_data_sp_sd)*samp_rate[s])),replace=TRUE)
      }
      names(age_data_sim) <-samp_dates
      age_data_sim_df <-map_df(age_data_sim,~as.data.frame(.))
      age_data_tab_sim <-table(age_data_sim_df)
      
      age_vec_sim<-c(as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_sim["1"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_sim["1"],0)),
                     as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_sim["2"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_sim["2"],0)),
                     as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_sim["3"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_sim["3"],0)),
                     as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_sim["4"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_sim["4"],0)),
                     as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_sim["5"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_sim["5"],0)),
                     as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_sim["6"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_sim["6"],0)))

      n_nom_b[[b]] <-sum(age_vec_sim)
      age_comps_b[[b]] <-age_vec_sim/sum(age_vec_sim)
      
    }
    n_nom_trt[[s]] <-n_nom_b
    age_comps_sim_trt[[s]] <-age_comps_b
  }
  names(n_nom_trt) <-samp_rate
  n_nom_sp[[sp]] <-n_nom_trt
  age_comps_real_sp[[sp]] <-age_comps_real
  names(age_comps_sim_trt) <-samp_rate
  age_comps_sim_sp[[sp]] <-age_comps_sim_trt
}
names(n_nom_sp) <-sp_name_list
names(age_comps_real_sp) <-sp_name_list
names(age_comps_sim_sp) <-sp_name_list

  }
}

# Set 'observed' proportions to real annual age comps, calc N_bt
# Could use mean of specimen bootstrap replicates if implemented 
samp_suite_sp <-list()

for(sp in 1:length(sp_name_list)){
  samp_suite <-list()
  
  for(trt in 1:length(samp_rate)){
    N_bt = matrix(NA, nrow=n_boot, ncol=length(sp_name_list))
    colnames(N_bt) <-sp_name_list
    # print(samp_rate[[trt]])
    
    for(bI in 1:n_boot){
      N_bt[bI,] = t(calculate_n(boot_ct=map_df(age_comps_sim_sp[[sp]][[trt]][[bI]],~as.data.frame(.)), 
                                obs_ct=map_df(age_comps_real_sp[[sp]],~as.data.frame(.))))
    }
    # # Calculate input sample size (harmonic mean across bootstrap samples)
    Nsamp_t = array(NA,dim=length(sp_name_list))
    Nsamp_t = apply(N_bt, MARGIN=2, FUN=harmonic.mean)
    samp_suite[[trt]] <-Nsamp_t

  }
  names(samp_suite) <-samp_rate
  samp_suite_sp[[sp]] <-samp_suite
}
names(samp_suite_sp) <-sp_name_list

fig_dat                <-map_df(samp_suite_sp,~as.data.frame(.))
colnames(fig_dat)      <-samp_rate
fig_dat$species        <-sp_name_list
fig_dat_long           <-melt(setDT(fig_dat), id.vars = c("species"), variable.name = "trt")
colnames(fig_dat_long) <-c("species", "trt", "n_eff")
fig_dat_long           <-fig_dat_long[order(fig_dat_long$species,fig_dat_long$trt),]

for(sp in 1:length(sp_name_list)){

      n_nom_df$trt <-rep(samp_rate[[s]], n_boot)
      n_nom_df$species <-rep(sp_name_list[[sp]], n_boot)
    }

      temp <-data.frame(n_nom = as.numeric(n_nom_sp[[sp]][[s]]))
      temp$trt <-rep(samp_rate[[s]], n_boot)
      temp$species <-rep(sp_name_list[[sp]], n_boot)
      n_nom_df <-rbind(n_nom_df, temp)
    }
  }
}

# **Introduction**

This script contains a bootstrap estimator for otolith samples collected where various hypothetical sampling rate scenarios (10-100% by 10% increments) are explored. Simulated age compositions are produced for a number of bootstrap samples designated by the user by stepping through the reported sampling dates for each year included and sampling otolith ages at the specified rate for each treatment. Effective sample size is then calculated for each sampling rate treatment and summarized as the harmonic mean (Stewart & Hamel, 2014; Eq. 6) across bootstrap replicates.

## Setup, pull data, and format

Use this section to load libraries, set directories, and designate any life history or geographic groupings. Then read in the data, calculate brood year returns, and format for model fitting.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#####################################################################################################################################################
### Clear workspace
rm(list=ls())

### Load libraries
library(ggplot2);library(ggh4x);library(ggthemes);library(ggeffects);library(kableExtra);
library(tidyr);library(dplyr);library(data.table);library(purrr);library(readr)
library(lubridate);library(janitor);library(stringi);library(rmdformats);
library(nlme);library(MuMIn);library(Hmisc);library(mgcv);library(scales);
library(odbc);library(RODBC);library(DBI);library(stringr);library(mgcv);
library(RJSONIO);library(RCurl);library(httr);library(jsonlite);library(glmmTMB);

### Set up drives, seed, & controls
drive          <-paste0("C:/Users/sism1477/OneDrive - Washington State Executive Branch Agencies/Desktop/R5 HM&E/wdfw_age_be/")
`%nin%`        <-negate(`%in%`) # create an exclude operator
# source(paste(drive,"/Functions/Functions.R",sep="")) #Source seed function to create seedlist; only run once then turn off
load(paste(drive,"/seed.list_v2",sep="")) #load seed folder again
bootest.seed <- as.numeric(seed.list[[1]][,"bootest.seed3"]) #read recruitment seed from seedlist function
n_boot <-1000 # settled on 1000

### Species designations
sp_name_list  <-c("Chum") #, "chinook", "pink", "coho", "sockeye", "steelhead", "cutthroat", "rainbow", "bull trout"

### Read-in age data & calc real age comps
# chum25                    <-read.csv(paste0(drive,"chum_ages_wallace_2025.csv"))
chum24                    <-read.csv(paste0(drive,"chum_ages_wallace_2024.csv"))
chum20_23                 <-read.csv(paste0(drive,"chum_ages_wallace_2020-2023.csv"))
age_data                  <-rbind(chum24[,c("species_description","location_name","sample_datetime", "gilbert_rich")],
                                  # chum25[,c("species_description","location_name","sample_datetime", "gilbert_rich")],
                                  chum20_23[,c("species_description","location_name","sample_datetime", "gilbert_rich")])
age_data                  <-filter(age_data, gilbert_rich!=c("Unreadable"))
age_data$return_yr        <-as.character(substr(age_data$sample_datetime,1,4))
age_data$return_yr        <-as.numeric(age_data$return_yr)
age_data$month_date       <-as.character(substr(age_data$sample_datetime,6,10))
age_data$gilbert_rich_int <-substr(chartr("₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉", "0123456789", age_data$gilbert_rich),1,1)
age_data$gilbert_rich_int <-as.numeric(age_data$gilbert_rich_int)

# Calculate N_bt
calculate_n = function(boot_ct, obs_ct){
  # boot_ct  = standardize(boot_ct)
  # obs_ct   = standardize(obs_ct)
  num_ct   = boot_ct*(1-boot_ct)
  denom_ct = (boot_ct - obs_ct)^2
  colSums(num_ct)/colSums(denom_ct)
}

# Calculate harmonic mean of N_bt
harmonic.mean = function(vec) 1/mean(1/vec)

```


# **Annual Estimator**

Effective sample size is often used to gauge the level of information content present in each year of age composition data included in a stock assessment framework  However, it can also be useful in a sampling design capacity to inform the agency on the quality of sampling efforts year-to-year. Therefore, this section of the script is designed to calculate an effective sample size for each sampling year and each user-specified sampling rate treatment.

## Resample Age Data

The available age data are bootstrapped 1,000 times per scenario (sp X yr X trt), thus creating 1,000 simulated age comps per scenario.

```{r boot_yr}
### Set up bootstrapping parameters
age_comps_real_sp <-list()
age_comps_sim_trt <-list()
age_comps_sim_sp <-list()
age_data_sim <-list()
n_nom_sp <-list()
samp_rate <-c(seq(0.1,1,0.1))
# print(Sys.time())
# sp=b=1
# s=10
# y=4

for(sp in 1:length(sp_name_list)){
  age_comps_real <-list()
  n_nom_trt <-list()
  yrs <-sort(unique(dplyr::filter(age_data, species_description==sp_name_list[sp])$return_yr))

  for(s in 1:length(samp_rate)){
    age_comps_b <-list()
    n_nom_b <-list()
    # print(samp_rate[[s]])
    
    for(b in 1:n_boot){
      # print(b)
      set.seed(bootest.seed[b])
      age_comps_sim <-list()
      n_nom_y <-list()
      
      for(y in 1:length(yrs)){
        ### Calc real age comps for each year
        age_data_sp_y <-dplyr::filter(age_data, species_description==sp_name_list[sp] & return_yr==yrs[y])
        age_data_tab_real <-table(age_data_sp_y$gilbert_rich_int)
    
        age_vec   <-c(as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_real["1"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_real["1"],0)),
                        as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_real["2"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_real["2"],0)),
                        as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_real["3"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_real["3"],0)),
                        as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_real["4"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_real["4"],0)),
                        as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_real["5"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_real["5"],0)),
                        as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_real["6"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_real["6"],0)))
        
        age_comps_real[[y]] <-age_vec/sum(age_vec)
        
        samp_dates <-unique(age_data_sp_y$month_date)
        age_data_sim <-list()
        
        for(sd in 1:length(samp_dates)){
          
          # for(or in 1:length(origin)){
            age_data_sp_y_sd <-dplyr::filter(age_data_sp_y, month_date==samp_dates[sd])
            age_data_sim[[sd]] <-sample(age_data_sp_y_sd$gilbert_rich_int,size=floor(round(nrow(age_data_sp_y_sd)*samp_rate[s])),replace=TRUE)
          # }
        
        }
        names(age_data_sim) <-samp_dates
        age_data_sim_df <-map_df(age_data_sim,~as.data.frame(.))
        age_data_tab_sim <-table(age_data_sim_df)
        
        age_vec_sim<-c(as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_sim["1"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_sim["1"],0)),
                       as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_sim["2"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_sim["2"],0)),
                       as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_sim["3"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_sim["3"],0)),
                       as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_sim["4"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_sim["4"],0)),
                       as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_sim["5"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_sim["5"],0)),
                       as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_sim["6"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_sim["6"],0)))
  
        n_nom_y[[y]] <-sum(age_vec_sim)
        age_comps_sim[[y]] <-age_vec_sim/sum(age_vec_sim)
      }
      names(n_nom_y) <-yrs
      n_nom_b[[b]] <-n_nom_y
      names(age_comps_real) <-yrs
      names(age_comps_sim) <-yrs
      age_comps_b[[b]] <-age_comps_sim
    }
    n_nom_trt[[s]] <-n_nom_b
    age_comps_sim_trt[[s]] <-age_comps_b
  }
  names(n_nom_trt) <-samp_rate
  n_nom_sp[[sp]] <-n_nom_trt
  age_comps_real_sp[[sp]] <-age_comps_real
  names(age_comps_sim_trt) <-samp_rate
  age_comps_sim_sp[[sp]] <-age_comps_sim_trt
}
names(n_nom_sp) <-sp_name_list
names(age_comps_real_sp) <-sp_name_list
names(age_comps_sim_sp) <-sp_name_list

for(sp in 1:length(sp_name_list)){
  for(s in 1:length(samp_rate)){
    if(s==1){age_comps_sim_df <-cbind(as.data.frame(t(map_df(age_comps_sim_sp[[sp]][[s]],~as.data.frame(.)))),yrs)}
    if(s>1){
      temp <-cbind(as.data.frame(t(map_df(age_comps_sim_sp[[sp]][[s]],~as.data.frame(.)))),yrs)
      age_comps_sim_df <-rbind(temp, age_comps_sim_df)
    }
  }
}

# Table of samples taken per sampling date
sample_tab <-t(table(age_data[,c("return_yr","month_date")]))
tab_with_sums <- addmargins(sample_tab, 1) # 1 specifies adding row margins (sums of columns)
```

## Calculate data weights (n_eff) & plot

The simulated age comps are then compared to the real age comps using the following calculation:

INSERT EQ. 6 HERE

and the n_eff is calculated as the harmonic mean across bootstrap replicates. 

```{r inputSS_yr}
# Set 'observed' proportions to real annual age comps, calc N_bt
# Could use mean of specimen bootstrap replicates if implemented 
samp_suite_sp <-list()

for(sp in 1:length(sp_name_list)){
  samp_suite <-list()
  
  for(trt in 1:length(samp_rate)){
    N_bt = matrix(NA, nrow=n_boot, ncol=length(yrs))
    colnames(N_bt) <-yrs
    # print(samp_rate[[trt]])
    
    for(y in 1:length(yrs)){
      for(bI in 1:n_boot){
        N_bt[bI,y] = t(calculate_n(boot_ct=map_df(age_comps_sim_sp[[sp]][[trt]][[bI]][[y]],~as.data.frame(.)), 
                                  obs_ct=map_df(age_comps_real_sp[[sp]][[y]],~as.data.frame(.))))
      }
    }
    # # Calculate input sample size (harmonic mean across bootstrap samples)
    Nsamp_t = array(NA,dim=length(yrs))
    Nsamp_t = apply(N_bt, MARGIN=2, FUN=harmonic.mean)
    samp_suite[[trt]] <-Nsamp_t

  }
  names(samp_suite) <-samp_rate
  samp_suite_sp[[sp]] <-samp_suite
}
names(samp_suite_sp) <-sp_name_list

fig_dat                <-map_df(samp_suite_sp,~as.data.frame(.))
colnames(fig_dat)      <-samp_rate
fig_dat$return_yr      <-rownames(fig_dat)
fig_dat_long           <-melt(setDT(fig_dat), id.vars = c("return_yr"), variable.name = "trt")
colnames(fig_dat_long) <-c("return_yr", "trt", "n_eff")
fig_dat_long           <-fig_dat_long[order(fig_dat_long$return_yr,fig_dat_long$trt),]

for(sp in 1:length(sp_name_list)){
  for(s in 1:length(samp_rate)){
    if(s==1){
      n_nom_df <-rbindlist(n_nom_sp[[sp]][[s]], fill=FALSE)
      n_nom_df$trt <-rep(samp_rate[[s]], n_boot)
    }
    if(s>1){
      temp <-rbindlist(n_nom_sp[[sp]][[s]], fill=FALSE)
      temp$trt <-rep(samp_rate[[s]], n_boot)
      n_nom_df <-rbind(n_nom_df, temp)
    }
  }
}

n_nom_df_long           <-melt(setDT(n_nom_df), id.vars = c("trt"), variable.name = "return_yr")
colnames(n_nom_df_long) <-c("trt","return_yr","n_nom")
```

# **Species-level Estimator**

In this section, effective sample size is calculated using all years of age data combined.

## Resample Age Data

```{r boot_sp}
### Set up bootstrapping parameters
age_comps_real_sp <-list()
age_comps_sim_trt <-list()
age_comps_sim_sp <-list()
age_data_sim <-list()
n_nom_sp <-list()
samp_rate <-c(seq(0.1,1,0.1))
# print(Sys.time())
# sp=b=s=1

for(sp in 1:length(sp_name_list)){
  age_comps_real <-list()
  n_nom_trt <-list()

  ### Calc real age comps for each year
  age_data_sp <-dplyr::filter(age_data, species_description==sp_name_list[sp])
  age_data_tab_real <-table(age_data_sp$gilbert_rich_int)

  age_vec   <-c(as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_real["1"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_real["1"],0)),
                as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_real["2"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_real["2"],0)),
                as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_real["3"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_real["3"],0)),
                as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_real["4"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_real["4"],0)),
                as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_real["5"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_real["5"],0)),
                as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_real["6"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_real["6"],0)))
  
  age_comps_real[[sp]] <-age_vec/sum(age_vec)
  
  samp_dates <-sort(unique(age_data_sp$month_date))


  for(s in 1:length(samp_rate)){
    age_comps_b <-list()
    n_nom_b <-list()
    # message("Treatment: ",samp_rate[[s]])
    
    for(b in 1:n_boot){
      # print(b)
      set.seed(bootest.seed[b])
      age_comps_sim <-list()
      age_data_sim <-list()
        
      for(sd in 1:length(samp_dates)){
          age_data_sp_sd <-dplyr::filter(age_data_sp, month_date==samp_dates[sd])
          age_data_sim[[sd]] <-sample(age_data_sp_sd$gilbert_rich_int,size=floor(round(nrow(age_data_sp_sd)*samp_rate[s])),replace=TRUE)
      }
      names(age_data_sim) <-samp_dates
      age_data_sim_df <-map_df(age_data_sim,~as.data.frame(.))
      age_data_tab_sim <-table(age_data_sim_df)
      
      age_vec_sim<-c(as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_sim["1"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_sim["1"],0)),
                     as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_sim["2"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_sim["2"],0)),
                     as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_sim["3"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_sim["3"],0)),
                     as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_sim["4"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_sim["4"],0)),
                     as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_sim["5"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_sim["5"],0)),
                     as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(age_data_tab_sim["6"])==FALSE,age_data_tab_sim["6"],0)))

      n_nom_b[[b]] <-sum(age_vec_sim)
      age_comps_b[[b]] <-age_vec_sim/sum(age_vec_sim)
      
    }
    n_nom_trt[[s]] <-n_nom_b
    age_comps_sim_trt[[s]] <-age_comps_b
  }
  names(n_nom_trt) <-samp_rate
  n_nom_sp[[sp]] <-n_nom_trt
  age_comps_real_sp[[sp]] <-age_comps_real
  names(age_comps_sim_trt) <-samp_rate
  age_comps_sim_sp[[sp]] <-age_comps_sim_trt
}
names(n_nom_sp) <-sp_name_list
names(age_comps_real_sp) <-sp_name_list
names(age_comps_sim_sp) <-sp_name_list

for(sp in 1:length(sp_name_list)){
  for(s in 1:length(samp_rate)){
    if(s==1){age_comps_sim_df <-as.data.frame(t(map_df(age_comps_sim_sp[[sp]][[s]],~as.data.frame(.))))}
    if(s>1){
      temp <-as.data.frame(t(map_df(age_comps_sim_sp[[sp]][[s]],~as.data.frame(.))))
      age_comps_sim_df <-rbind(temp, age_comps_sim_df)
    }
  }
}
```

## Calculate data weights (n_eff) & plot

```{r inputSS_sp}
# Set 'observed' proportions to real annual age comps, calc N_bt
# Could use mean of specimen bootstrap replicates if implemented 
samp_suite_sp <-list()

for(sp in 1:length(sp_name_list)){
  samp_suite <-list()
  
  for(trt in 1:length(samp_rate)){
    N_bt = matrix(NA, nrow=n_boot, ncol=length(sp_name_list))
    colnames(N_bt) <-sp_name_list
    # print(samp_rate[[trt]])
    
    for(bI in 1:n_boot){
      N_bt[bI,] = t(calculate_n(boot_ct=map_df(age_comps_sim_sp[[sp]][[trt]][[bI]],~as.data.frame(.)), 
                                obs_ct=map_df(age_comps_real_sp[[sp]],~as.data.frame(.))))
    }
    # # Calculate input sample size (harmonic mean across bootstrap samples)
    Nsamp_t = array(NA,dim=length(sp_name_list))
    Nsamp_t = apply(N_bt, MARGIN=2, FUN=harmonic.mean)
    samp_suite[[trt]] <-Nsamp_t

  }
  names(samp_suite) <-samp_rate
  samp_suite_sp[[sp]] <-samp_suite
}
names(samp_suite_sp) <-sp_name_list

fig_dat                <-map_df(samp_suite_sp,~as.data.frame(.))
colnames(fig_dat)      <-samp_rate
fig_dat$species        <-sp_name_list
fig_dat_long           <-melt(setDT(fig_dat), id.vars = c("species"), variable.name = "trt")
colnames(fig_dat_long) <-c("species", "trt", "n_eff")
fig_dat_long           <-fig_dat_long[order(fig_dat_long$species,fig_dat_long$trt),]

for(sp in 1:length(sp_name_list)){
  for(s in 1:length(samp_rate)){
    if(s==1){
      n_nom_df <-data.frame(n_nom = as.numeric(n_nom_sp[[sp]][[s]]))
      n_nom_df$trt <-rep(samp_rate[[s]], n_boot)
      n_nom_df$species <-rep(sp_name_list[[sp]], n_boot)
    }
    if(s>1){
      temp <-data.frame(n_nom = as.numeric(n_nom_sp[[sp]][[s]]))
      temp$trt <-rep(samp_rate[[s]], n_boot)
      temp$species <-rep(sp_name_list[[sp]], n_boot)
      n_nom_df <-rbind(n_nom_df, temp)
    }
  }
}
```

# **Log-log GLMM fit of n_eff \~ n_samp**

This section fits a gneralized linear model to the n_eff ~ n_samp relationship. The slope of this relationship can be interpreted as a 1% change in sampling equates to a 1% change in information content.

```{r glmm}
mod <-glmmTMB( log(n_eff) ~ 1 + log(n_nom)*( 1 + log(n_nom)),data=fig_dat_long)
print(mod)
LOGLOGslope <-mod[["fit"]][["par"]][[2]]
mod_pred <-ggpredict(mod, terms = "n_nom")
colnames(mod_pred) <-c("n_nom", "n_eff", "std.error", "conf.low", "conf.high", "group")


base_plot <- ggplot(data = fig_dat_long, aes(x = log(n_nom), y = log(n_eff))) +
      geom_point()

base_plot +
  geom_line(data = mod_pred, aes(x = log(n_nom), y = log(n_eff)), color = "blue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(data = mod_pred, aes(x = log(n_nom), ymin = log(conf.low), ymax = log(conf.high)), alpha = 0.2, fill = "lightblue4")


```
